basic_info.description: If you've been waiting for an incredible townhouse in one of the best locations in all of San Francisco... welcome home! This 2,300 sqft three-bedroom, two-bathroom home with a two-car garage has just hit the market for the first time in over 40 years. Freshly updated paint, flooring, countertops, and more give you the opportunity to move right in and begin enjoying this townhome treasure. Take breathtaking walks to Sutro Tower, Noe Valley, and all the best that San Francisco has to offer. This quiet complex provides the tranquility you need to enjoy life on a daily basis. Don't hesitate...make sure to put this home at the top of your must-see list before its gone!
